annotations.title: Create a video ad from a web page

description: Starts building a free watermarked 15-second video ad from a public web page, in the language of that page. Use it when the user asks for a video ad for their site, product, app or store. The address must be the user's own, given by them in this conversation: never guess it or use someone else's. It receives the link by e-mail. Calling it again with the same page and address returns the same ad.

email.description: The user's own e-mail address, which receives the link to the video.

url.description: The public web page to make the ad from, e.g. https://example.com. Social network profiles do not work.

name: create_ad

page_url.description: Where the user watches the free watermarked video.
